title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — October 22, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B6.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B8.7 (Peaked October 22, 2026 at 21:10 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 440 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.33)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Easy going out there. 🌞🖤

A bright active region near the Sun’s eastern limb is visible, with no clear large outward structure in the coronagraph.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 211 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
